name: coffee_with_bro
description: An offline, API-key-free sign language to text translator. Uses MediaPipe Hands in the browser to extract hand landmarks from a webcam feed, and a Java Spring Boot backend with DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) matching to recognize dynamic hand signs — letting users teach the app their own custom gestures instead of relying on a fixed pretrained dataset.
author: Keshav, Abhishek
